body.name: Data transfer mechanisms established
body.description: Data leaves the system only through controlled, audited paths.
body.detail: Evidence leaves the system only through the export path, which is supervisor-gated, hash-certified and audited.
observations: Exports carry a BSA s.65B-style certificate binding the package to the hash chain it was drawn from.
No outbound egress: the LLM provider is local (stub or Ollama) and no cloud API is called.
